context: Request: build an MFN clause bank for M&A and commercial drafting; pull all deals with a 'most favored nation' provision. Rubric: 17 qualifying matters (1001-00002, 1001-00007, 1003-00003, 1004-00001, 1005-00001, 1008-00003, 1009-00001, 1013-00002, 1013-00003, 1018-00006, 1019-00002, 1021-00001, 1022-00008, 1023-00001, 1027-00002, 1041-00003, 1042-00002) plus a precision criterion; drafts, term sheets, diligence-only references and sibling matters (e.g. 1003-00002, 1043-00001, 1044-00002, 1037-00004) are outside the set.

stages.note: Whole-store glob in parallel with a find capped at 200 lines.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2). Saves the full path list and prints file, matter and extension counts with per-matter file counts.

stages.note: Reads the openings of twelve agreements and side letters from about ten candidates. The review flags one document per matter and many surfaced matters never opened.

stages.note: declared: Search within a candidate matter's files. Reads the first 35 lines of eight execution agreements from eight candidates. The review flags that cover pages cannot show the clause and that the file-name filter can drop matters; its label note names screening.

stages.stage: Tabulate candidate matters from saved results
stages.note: declared: Search within a candidate matter's files (attempt 2). Per-matter tally of all 76 candidates from the saved candidate file, marking a 'primary' document by file name. The review flags that the primary flag comes from file names, not text; its label note names the scan stage.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes 17 qualifying matters with clauses and paths, and lists draft-only, diligence-only and near-match candidates separately. The review asks to confirm each excluded candidate has a reason.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response; a path check fails on an outdated file location, then three citation paths are completed and all 54 cited paths are confirmed.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 2: re-reads six cited sources; no edits. The review's label note names listing reads.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 3: reads the response opening and extracts the clauses of three cited agreements; no edits. The review flags that the demotions of unopened matters rest on snippets.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.failure_point: It saw clause hits for a financing matter only in snippets of files with draft-like names, never opened that matter, and listed it as draft-only.

first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) The reviews at [70] and [109] warned that draft or operative status was inferred from file names and snippets and asked to open the executed documents of unopened matters to confirm exclusions; the matter was not named (the unopened-matters list was cut before it) and the agent finished without opening it.
first_error.why: A financing matter whose clause hits sat in instrument files with draft-like names was put in the draft-only list on file names and snippets alone, though its folder also held a board consent and closing letter; none of its documents was opened (evidence seen at [46]-[53] and [67]-[68]).

runs.failure_point: It built a complete strict-hit candidate list but read only hand-picked matters, so four surfaced matters never entered the answer; it also excluded a read matter as not executed, paired one credit agreement with the wrong borrower and counted a sibling matter's side-letter program.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) The review at [84] flagged a hand-picked read list and an unwidened pool; the stock unopened-matters lists at [90] and [114] included two of the left-out matters among about 40 names; no reading stage opened any of them.
first_error.why: Four matters with strict-term hits in the scan and the saved candidate list (seen at [49] and [63]) were left out of this and every later reading batch, so the answer omits them.

other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) The screening review at [114] said a follow-on note financing read there was cited under its sibling matter and asked to re-read both to settle which holds the proof document; the agent wrote without doing so.
other_errors.why: A follow-on note financing whose purchase agreement was read twice (evidence seen at [93]-[103]) was excluded because its documents were not marked as an execution version, with its sibling matter cited instead.

other_errors.critic_note: No review compared the credit-facility rows with the documents read.
other_errors.why: A revolving credit matter is described as another borrower's term loan: the parallel read batch at [70]-[80] returned that other credit agreement next to this matter's read, and the pairing was carried into the table though the re-read at [93]-[96] showed the real borrower.

other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) The review at [84] said the side-letter program of that matter was counted as confirmed without separating executed letters from drafts; it stayed in the counted table, and later check stages removed only a different draft matter.
other_errors.why: A sibling matter's investor side-letter program, read at [70]-[82], is counted as an operative clause matter in place of the related credit-agreement matter.

runs.failure_point: It reached every qualifying matter but wrote an inventory that counts drafts, term sheets and diligence-only clauses beside operative provisions, and the check stages kept them as labelled supplements.

first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The write review at [78] said term sheets, settlements, drafts and target-contract clauses were folded into the count; the check stages separated a strict subset but kept every entry in the inventory, and the last review at [110] approved finishing without demoting any matter.
first_error.why: The answer presents drafts, term sheets, rejected proposals and clauses in acquired companies' contracts as deals with the clause, alongside the operative ones (evidence seen at [46]-[72]).

divergence: All three runs fail, each on a different criterion and at a different stage. All three listed the store, ran a complete store-wide extraction scan that surfaced every qualifying matter, and then screened with opening-page reads and snippet scripts. T0 missed one matter at the write stage: its clause hits sat in draft-named files, it was never opened, and it went to the draft-only list (reviews warned generically about file-name and snippet classification). T1 left four surfaced matters out of every reading batch (first error at its first screening stage, reviews flagged hand-picking generically) and then made three write-stage errors: an exclusion after a read, a borrower taken from a parallel read of another matter, and a sibling matter's side-letter program counted (the last two partly named by reviews). T2 included every qualifying matter but counted drafts, term sheets and diligence-only clauses beside them; the write review named that specifically, the check stages only relabelled them, and the final review approved finishing. No run followed a label note; T1 declared two new stages for re-running and saving the scan, both of which are scan work.
